# Linear relations in validation constraints

Goal remains verified CPU AVX single-proof >=10x supplied M5CPU ALL8 with CPU/Metal comparisons;0/8. Previous goal turn completed fresh AWS comparison and cleanup, pushed2fbefc268b. No live job/cloud. Canonical46167 remains accepted-current-c7a176/proof-sha256-after-capture.json.

New question: can already-solved validation rows eliminate query terms? Prior affine-closure176 only derives new assignment values and explicitly excludes facts from constraints without assignments. Reuse its byte reader and affine-form utilities, not its census execution or old tests. Each original wire stays its own formal variable. Stored sums expand exactly; nonlinear assignments stay formal wires. Examine every non-assigning R1CS A*B=C row. HintKind::Bits unconditionally returns0/1, so replace ONLY diagonal b*b by b for those certified hint outputs. All remaining quadratic coefficients must cancel exactly. No witness assumptions, unknown-divisor cancellation, Boolean fact about inverse hints or approximate equality.

Record nonzero linear relations, exact sparse private-column pivot rank, and separately the rank of relations supported entirely on each original A/B query. Public wires cannot be eliminated. This latter count excludes support expansion; it does not qualify a key transformation or prove achievable savings. Retain literal linear/Boolean-enabled/tautological counts and match hint reconstruction expressions to actual relation rows. These are mathematical counts, not point additions, timings or proof savings. General nonlinear implications, other hint semantics and all larger shapes remain outside scope.

Three new tests: sparse private rank versus independent Arkworks dense elimination over256different matrices; exact Boolean polynomial cancellation with cross terms retained; complete synthetic solver image including unassigned recomposition and Boolean validation, plus every truncated prefix. Native field/source/parser provenance inherited. Two immutable old solver images are new inputs to this validation-row question; do not rerun their old producer/assignment census, accepted arithmetic suites or SDK/proof captures. Review actual relation arithmetic/rank separately before any implementation selection. Preserve failures. No key changes/table/solver-plan/pool/RAMcap or measured RAM/speed claim.

Prior source review also closes unchanged CSR bucket trees/native intermediate/retained-deque/PMNS/quadratic proposals: their reports preserve concrete negatives. Fresh Gaussian/Eisenstein literature lookup https://www.mdpi.com/2410-387X/5/1/6 and https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.03741 introduces no new measured algorithm; the prior quadratic-fq-screen already implements that family. No third-party speed estimate transfers. This validation-constraint hypothesis is a local derivation from solver semantics.

Rust1.98.1 and serializedxtask; no Python/subagents. No new proofs/exports/timing/profile expected. Report honestly, commitANDpush completed experiment, update checkpoint, continue full original objective. ANYfuture functionalpreflight/recording onlypoll exactconfirmedlivehandle untilterminal, no overlappingownedCPUhelperwork. Everyfutureproofexport MUSTseedcanonical46167. Never relax prior gates or rescue closed candidate via worker/platform subset.
